description: Failure → Fix → Re-test ledger. Every test failure encountered during the 2026-07 hardening + MPF migration cycle, with root cause, the fixing commit, and the green re-test evidence. A suite that is only ever green proves nothing; this ledger proves the tests can fail, and that failures get fixed and re-proven — never ignored.

entries.failed: Firestore rules-deployed regression test: 2 probes errored (users/{uid}/quotes subcollection checks)
entries.rootCause: Test bug — probe used '__rules_probe__' as a quote id; double-underscore ids are RESERVED in Firestore and return 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT, miscounted as a denial.
entries.fix: Probe id changed to 'rulesprobe' (tests/firestore-rules-deployed.spec.ts), commit b378d08

entries.failed: End-to-end data-chain test 8/10: collectionGroup quotes queries FAILED_PRECONDITION; accept-variation collectionGroup read 403
entries.rootCause: Product gap — missing collection-group indexes (quotes.organisationId etc.) and missing recursive variations read rule.
entries.fix: 5 fieldOverrides added to firestore.indexes.json + recursive match /{path=**}/variations rule, commit fd984a7; deployed via Firebase CLI; index backfill awaited

entries.failed: Data-chain step 'collectionGroup quotes finds new quote' still failing after index backfill (9/10)
entries.rootCause: Test bug — unordered limit-50 probe across 136 org quotes can't guarantee a fresh quote appears; also wrote createdAt as timestampValue while the app stores ISO strings (different Firestore type buckets sort separately).
entries.fix: Probe rewritten to mirror the app's real query (org filter + createdAt DESC on the composite index) with string createdAt

entries.failed: Smoke battery first run 2011/2014: contentOverrides, compatibilityRules, sentEmails org-path LISTs returned 403
entries.rootCause: Test bug — probes targeted organisations/{org}/... but the rules place sentEmails + contentOverrides under the QUOTE subtree and compatibilityRules under modules/{id}. Deployed rules were correct; the checks were wrong.
entries.fix: scripts/smoke-1000.py section B re-pointed at the real rule parents, commit f38ff66

entries.failed: Smoke battery route checks: /proposals HTTP 404; /feature-tracking flagged for error-boundary text
entries.rootCause: Test bugs — /proposals only exists as /proposals/[quoteNumber] (bare-path 404 is correct); 'Something went wrong' legitimately appears 3× inside the v1.9.5 release-notes CONTENT baked into /feature-tracking.
entries.fix: Route list corrected + error check narrowed to Next's real crash marker ('Application error'), commit 3456e16

entries.failed: Playwright browser suite: all tests ERR_CONNECTION_RESET against dev URL and localhost login timeout in the sandbox
entries.rootCause: Environment — Chromium doesn't inherit HTTPS_PROXY, and its post-quantum/ECH TLS ClientHello breaks the sandbox's TLS-intercepting proxy mid-CONNECT.
entries.fix: playwright.evidence.config.ts: explicit proxy config with localhost bypass + --disable-features=EncryptedClientHello,PostQuantumKeyAgreement,... launch flags
entries.retest: In-browser Firebase auth verified working through the proxy; visual-regression suite login flow exercises it end-to-end

entries.failed: TypeScript typecheck: 93 errors repo-wide (build only passed because ignoreBuildErrors was set)
entries.rootCause: Accumulated type debt: RHF field-path collapse from a passthrough index signature, firebase/react-day-picker API drift, missing icon imports, implicit anys, es2018 regex flags under an ES2017 target.
entries.fix: All 93 fixed properly (types only, zero runtime changes) across ~20 files + tsconfig target ES2020
entries.retest: tsc --noEmit: 0 errors; production build succeeds; 451 unit tests green on the combined tree

entries.failed: Unit tests exposed 3 money-math defects (pinned with TODO-BUG markers): over-discount drives totals negative; explicit cost:0 overridden by margin heuristics (|| vs ??); >100% payment allocation yields a negative final line
entries.rootCause: Product bugs in src/lib/quote-financials.ts + payment-schedule lib.
entries.fix: buildQuoteFinancials clamps discount to subtotal (finalTotalPriceExclGst = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount); GST from the floored value); all 0.7/0.8/0.85 cost fallbacks switched from || to ?? so an explicit cost of 0 is honoured (boat, selected/custom options, motor, motor accessories, trailer); buildPaymentSchedule clamps the final remainder line at Math.max(0, total - allocated) so >100% allocation never yields a negative line. Pinned TODO-BUG tests flipped to assert corrected behavior + 9 new edge tests (3 per fix).
entries.retest: GREEN — 12 unit tests assert corrected behavior (3 flipped + 9 new edges); full suite 460/460 PASS; tsc --noEmit 0 errors; production build passes

entries.failed: Boats import dry-run planned duplicate vendors (data-warehouse/stacer alongside existing Stacer vendor LWgHuGoKfUBeKZ8eWnEi)
entries.rootCause: Importer written before the live-vendor probe; 5 of 8 brands already had vendors + modules; Merry Fisher/Cap Camarat are Jeanneau lines.
entries.fix: BRAND_ROUTING map added to scripts/mpf/import-boats.py — existing vendor ids, MF/CC as Jeanneau ranges, only Formosa net-new
entries.retest: Dry-run re-run confirms zero duplicate vendors; verified before any --apply

entries.failed: CL380 quote flow: 'NO DEALER FIT OPTIONS CONFIGURED' (field report)

entries.fix: Reseeded via committed scripts/seed-dealerfit.py; junk E2E_TEMP_* categories cleaned off the module doc; permanent fix = MPF import of NSM's real 1,795 dealer-fit options
entries.retest: 9 options verified live via REST + user-confirmed in browser; MPF import supersedes

entries.failed: Boats apply died at write 334/1042 (connection reset by peer)
entries.rootCause: Environment — transient proxy connection reset; writer had token refresh but no transient retry.
entries.fix: Store._req retries connection resets + 429/5xx with exponential backoff (4 attempts)
entries.retest: GREEN — boats apply completed 1042/1042 (334 skipped-unchanged on resume, 248 updates, 460 creates), APPLY-2B-BOATS OK

entries.failed: Motors/Trailers/FO apply: HTTP 400 Bad Request on the first motor write
entries.rootCause: Product-of-migration bug — Yamaha motor rows keep original column names with spaces ('NSM Retail'); Firestore updateMask requires backtick-quoted field paths for non-identifier names.
entries.fix: _fs.patch_doc quotes flat field names whole (preserving literal dots e.g. 'Prop Part No.') and treats explicit masks as dotted nesting
entries.retest: GREEN — MTF apply completed 608 writes (motors updated+created, trailers 267 upd + 47 new, 1,011 factory options repriced), APPLY-3B-MTF OK

entries.failed: Image audit: 1,921 dealer-fit refs 403-blocked by NSM's own website WAF; 153 motor refs behind Incapsula; 314 SharePoint-internal refs; 4 dead links
entries.rootCause: MPF image links depend on external hosts: NSM WAF blocks non-browser fetchers, Yamaha runs a JS challenge, SharePoint links need M365 auth — none reliable for customer rendering.
entries.fix: 164 WAF-blocked images mirrored via weserv to Firebase Storage (mpf-mirror/), 896 dealerFitSelections docs re-pointed (1,792 refs); 7 recoverable Yamaha images mirrored (31 motor rows patched); unfetchable remainder documented for NSM (38 Yamaha + 7 SharePoint exports + 4 dead)
entries.retest: GREEN — all 171 mirrored Storage URLs re-probed 200 image/*; live doc spot-checks confirm Storage URLs serving

entries.failed: CL380 checklist walkthrough failed at first assertion (land on Step 1) after 3 dialog-open attempts; smoke suite same window passed 5/6 (1 flaky, recovered on retry)
entries.rootCause: Under investigation — a second Playwright browser (the ultimate-test HL leg) was confirmed running concurrently through the single sandbox TLS bridge; contention is the leading hypothesis (smoke login+quote-to-step6 passed in the same window, so the flow itself works on migrated data).
entries.fix: Serialize browser jobs — re-run checklist SOLO after the ultimate-test browser leg completes (quiet bridge).

entries.failed: Service module white-screened on one keystroke in the engine-schedule search (module-quotes verification, MQ-1)
entries.rootCause: MPF-imported engineServiceSchedules doc carries numeric familyCode (6000); engine-schedule-picker called .toLowerCase() on it.
entries.fix: String() casts on searchable fields in engine-schedule-picker.tsx
entries.retest: GREEN — production build rebuilt, picker re-driven in browser, line added successfully (evidence: module-quotes/debug-schedule-picker.png)

entries.failed: Step 5 dealer-fit rendered 'jibberish' for boats (field report, CL290): obsolete list heading (### OBSELETE MODEL LIST ###, 191 items), other models' option packs (Patrol 600 on a CL290), and workshop sections (PRE DELIVERY, RIGGING KITS) flooding the customer-facing step
entries.rootCause: MPF import faithfully carried all 93 Dealer Fit sheet sections as categories; the quote flow grouped ALL 1,791 options for every boat with no section relevance model.
entries.fix: Section classifier in groupedDealerFit: hidden (### / OBSELETE / PRE DELIVERY / RIGGING KIT / HELM MASTER / ADD ON KITS), model-scoped packs shown only on the matching boat (digits + range-word/brand agreement), general accessory categories always shown. Boat's own dealerFitLines strip unchanged on top.
entries.retest: typecheck 0 + build green; deployed to dev for field re-check on CL290; UI-audit after-pass covers the step

entries.failed: UI audit (UI-1): FFR-18 classifier gap — digitless range packs ('HIGHFIELD - PATROL', 100 options) still rendered on every boat (seen on SP560)
entries.rootCause: classifySection required digits to mark a section model-scoped; range-word-only sections fell through to 'general'.
entries.fix: Range words now mark sections model-scoped; a section naming a range only shows on that range; cross-digit mismatches hard-fail; brand-only packs still match by vendor.
entries.retest: typecheck 0; UI-audit after-pass re-screenshots SP560 + CL290 Step 5
